_README: Hand-pinned Google Places matches. step2_fetch_ratings.py looks these up by
id via the Place Details API instead of searching by name, so the match is
deterministic and cannot drift to another business.
A null place_id means the restaurant has no Google listing of its own and
must NOT be searched — a name search would land on a neighbour and recreate
the collision this file exists to fix.
Every entry here was researched and adversarially verified. See

Mojo East.note: 85 Stanton St, LES. Legitimate owner of this id; the sibling 'Mojo Omakase' row was matching it after the Chelsea original closed.

Sushi by Bou.note: 320 E 11th St. Already correct, pinned so the closed 'Robataya' row cannot drift onto it again.

Sushi Hayashi.note: 225 Grand St, Williamsburg. This is the row to keep; 'Sushi Hayashi (Williamsburg)' is a duplicate of it.

Momoya.note: Momoya SoHo, 47 Prince St. The closed 'Sushi by Bae' row was matching this.

Yūgin.note: YUGIN. Distinct from the 'Sushi Yugen' row, which is closed and has no listing.

Bar Masa.note: 10 Columbus Circle. Verified via barmasanyc.com / (212) 823-9802. Masa next door has no listing and was matching this.

Masa.note: OPEN and operating (masanyc.com, (212) 823-9807) but has no Google Places listing, so a name search falls through to Bar Masa next door. Detached deliberately. Do NOT mark this row closed - absence from Places is not closure, and this is the 3-Michelin flagship.

Omi Omakase.note: Correct match. The closed 'That Place Omakase' row was matching this.

Gyu-Ichiro.note: 135 Bowery. Current name of the business formerly branded Hiyake Omakase; same phone (917) 596-2414. The 'Hiyake Omakase (Bowery)' row is that old name.

Sushi by Bae.note: Closed, but its own listing survives flagged CLOSED_PERMANENTLY - pinning it is better than detaching, since the closure then derives and the address/coords are right. Chef Oona Tempest's 6-seat counter at 118A E 15th St; shut during COVID. Was matching Momoya SoHo.

Robataya.note: Robataya NY, 231 E 9th St, closed permanently 30 Dec 2017; space became Sakagura East Village. The only listing bearing the name is a ratingless, statusless stub that must NOT be pinned. Was matching Sushi by Bou.

Sushi Yugen.note: Closed Edomae counter at 1144 First Ave (Lenox Hill, not Upper Manhattan as the row says). No listing of its own; name search fell through to YUGIN, a different restaurant.

That Place Omakase.note: Closed. Real restaurant (14-course $98 matches the row) but no surviving listing; name search fell through to Omi Omakase in Flushing.

Mojo Omakase.note: Chelsea original at 177 9th Ave; the space and its Google listing are now SourAji West under the same owner, so no Mojo Omakase id exists. Do NOT repoint at SourAji West - different concept, and the dataset already has a separate SourAji row. Was matching its sibling Mojo East.

Masuda Omakase.note: Kosher omakase pop-up inside AO Bowl at 1385 Broadway; ran June 2023 to 31 March 2024, now catering only. No listing by name, phone, or 120m address sweep.
